confirm.title: Confirm You're OK
confirm.intro: Press the button below to check in to your Dead Man's Switch. This starts a new check-in cycle, just like checking in from the app. You don't need to sign in.
confirm.missingToken: This page needs the check-in link from your reminder email. Please open the link in the email again, or sign in to check in manually.
confirm.hint: Opening this page does not check you in. Only pressing the button does.
confirm.submitFailed: Could not check in right now. Please try again.

done.successTitle: You're Checked In — Dead Man's Switch Reset
done.successBody: We have confirmed that you are safe. Your Dead Man's Switch countdown has been reset for a new cycle.
done.errorTitle: Check-In Link Could Not Be Verified
done.errorGeneric: This check-in link is no longer valid.
done.errorHint: Please sign in to LegacyVault to check in manually.

reason.TOKEN_INVALID: This check-in link is invalid, expired, already used, or from an earlier reminder cycle.
reason.TRIGGERED: Your Dead Man's Switch has already started the handover process, so check-in is no longer possible.
reason.SUSPENDED: Your Dead Man's Switch is currently suspended by an administrator. Please contact an admin.
reason.NOT_CONFIGURED: Your Dead Man's Switch is not set up, so there is nothing to check in to. Please sign in and save the configuration.
